product_one_liner.value: Forwood Safety provides safety and critical-risk management software that helps organizations in high-risk industries prevent workplace fatalities and serious incidents.
product_one_liner.notes: Forwood describes its SaaS technology as preventing serious incidents and fatalities through critical-risk management; its investor identifies customers in high-risk industries including mining, construction and utilities. Sources: https://forwoodsafety.bamboohr.com/careers/160 and https://www.macquarie.com/pl/en/insights/investing-in-workplace-fatality-prevention-software.html

pricing_page.notes: No pricing link or public plans page was found in the inspected site navigation/footer, and the pricing URL did not return a pricing page. The site provides contact/demo inquiries, while G2 says pricing is unlisted and buyers must engage the vendor. Sources: https://forwoodsafety.com/, https://forwoodsafety.com/contact/ and https://www.g2.com/products/forwood-safety/pricing

eng_blog.notes: The reviewed News and Articles index contains safety guidance, product announcements, events and marketing content; it does not establish at least two engineer-authored articles about building the product. public_docs.notes: The public Help Center lists four Forwood Users articles and one Team Management article, satisfying the requirement for several public documentation articles. Source: https://help.forwoodsafety.com/en

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The live official board lists four openings: an Account Executive, a Senior Enterprise Sales Executive and two Industry & Critical Risk Management Specialist roles. None has a qualifying AI, ML or data-science title. Source: https://forwoodsafety.bamboohr.com/careers

model_provider.notes: Forwood publicly describes using Amazon QuickSight Q and explains that it uses machine learning to understand questions about business data. This identifies an AI service/provider, not a disclosed underlying foundation model. Source: https://forwoodsafety.com/forwood-amazon-quicksight-q-extend-life-saving-safety-analytics
